## Episode Thesis

This is a politics-focused Friday panel with former Moderate leader Anna Kinberg Batra and Katalys head Daniel Suhonen. They discuss the government's temporary half-price public transport as a response to the oil crisis, the tone of the Swedish election campaign, 1990s nostalgia and underrated regions for business. Companies come up only in passing: sponsor ads, a remark about the SpaceX listing lifting interest in space entrepreneurship around Kiruna, and a Pripps anecdote. Nobody gives a directional view on any stock.
